title: boronia pilosa var. lancifolia
intro: Boronia pilosa var. lancifolia, commonly known as Lance-leaf Boronia, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to eastern Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lance-leaf Boronia include its ability to reduce inflammation, combat bacterial and fungal infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Boronia pilosa var. lancifolia are primarily sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
